title: BuildSource
description: Specifies the source code location and type for the build input.

uri.description: The URL of the Git repository.

ref.description: The Git branch, tag, or commit to build.

dockerfile.description: The Dockerfile content used as build input.

contextDir.description: The subdirectory within the source repository used as the context for the build.

sourceSecret.description: Secret holding credentials for accessing the source repository.
